query:
SELECT DISTINCT shopName, COUNT(*) as orderCount 
FROM orders 
WHERE shopName LIKE '%ktk%' OR shopName LIKE '%CWB JOYCE%' OR shopName LIKE '%sogo%' OR shopName LIKE '%SOGO%'
GROUP BY shopName
ORDER BY shopName;
